thread:
maria: Hey team — planning a small, focused launch for the 'Starter Kit: GraphQL Refapp' (tutorial + tiny refapp + 20-min webinar). Goal: quick wins for devs to spin up Redwood with LLM inference hooks.

sam: Love it. Suggested deliverables: 1) 1-page tutorial, 2) GitHub repo with example infra (Docker + devcontainer), 3) 4-min demo video, 4) benchmark narrative doc showing latency/cost vs naive self-host.

ajay: I'll take the refapp repo and demo. Can someone pair on the benchmark tests? I want reproducible commands.

maria: @ajay thanks! @julia can you own the blog post + newsletter blurb?

julia: Yep. Draft ETA next Wed. Will need a couple of quotes and a hook line — thinking "deploy LLM features in minutes, not months" — ok?

tess: Fine with that hook, but let's avoid overpromising on latency. Maybe "deploy LLM features fast with predictable cost".

sam: For the benchmark narrative, propose we show: p50 latency, tokens/sec, cost per 1K tokens, and cold-start time. Also include config snippet:
```
# bench script
python bench.py --model redwood-3b --seq 256 --concurrency 8
```

ajay: For infra I'll add a /bench folder with scripts and a Dockerfile. Will tag commit with v0.1-demo.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: branch=refapp-demo, env=staging, eta=2026-04-01T15:00Z :rocket:

maria: Webinar? 20-min live + 10-min Q&A. Target devs and community. Who can present the demo? @ajay?

ajay: I can do the demo. Prefer pre-recorded demo + live Q&A.

sam: I'll draft webinar slide deck and a short prompt doc for attendees to try. Also want a quick survey for lead capture.

julia: Landing page CTA copy suggestion: "Try the Starter Kit — clone, run, and connect to an LLM in under 10 minutes." Add UTM params: ?utm_source=community&utm_campaign=starterkit_launch

tess: For inbound lead routing — marketing -> sales-qualified leads if survey says 'enterprise' and usage > 1000 tokens/day. Otherwise drip nurture. Need to wire up in HubSpot.

maria: Action items:
- ajay: repo + demo (due 2026-03-29)
- sam: tutorial + slides + bench script (2026-03-30)
- julia: blog + landing + newsletter (2026-04-01)
- tess: lead routing + tracking + SLA copy (2026-04-02)

sam: I'll add a tiny example prompt and benchmark snippet in the README:
```
POST /v1/generate
{ "model": "redwood-3b", "input": "Summarize: ..." }
```

ajay: tagging this thread with #launch-checklist and #community for visibility.

maria: Awesome — let's use this thread for async updates. Ping me when blockers come up. :sparkles:
